title: Relieving a Restocking Fee Standing against a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Return
content:
Where a Circle membership relieves part or all of a restocking fee standing against a Northbeam Returns and Restocking return, that relief is put on the return. The result the relief governs is the amount relieved. The relief is worked out only after the restocking fee it relieves stands charged against the return.

Recording it adds a waiver entry to the return's history carrying the amount relieved and the ground it rests on, and lowers the restocking fee still outstanding on the return by that amount. The customer can see what was taken off and why against their return from that moment, and the return's own outstanding figure moves with it. The return keeps the state it stands in, and the fee entry the waiver relieves is left as it stands.

## Recording the relief

The relief is recorded with `waive_restocking_fee_47bbe442`, which is a tool the agent unlocks and then calls.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `return_authorization_id` | the reference number of the return authorisation whose fee is being relieved, read from the return authorisation record retrieved for the customer before the call |
| `waived_fee_amount` | the amount of the fee being relieved, in USD to 2 decimal places, always positive, given to the cent with at most two decimal places and never carrying a currency symbol or thousands separator |
| `fee_waiver_reason` | the ground the relief rests on, exactly one of the six values below |

`fee_waiver_reason` takes exactly one of: `defective_item`, the item was graded as having failed or been damaged before the customer got it; `retailer_error`, the retailer sent or handled the wrong thing; `membership_benefit`, the customer's Circle membership relieves the fee; `goodwill`, the relief is given as a gesture with no other ground; `business_contract_term`, a business contract term provides for it; `none`, no ground is recorded.

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the waiver entry reference that was created, the amount relieved in USD to two decimal places, the ground recorded and the restocking fee now outstanding on the return. The sentence appearing at all means the entry was written and the outstanding figure has moved.
